sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/bridger-teton/recreation/whiskey-grove-campground (read 2026-11-20; 'Site Open'; last updated October 2, 2026): 'This campground is located in the Upper Green River valley, situated right on the Green River. Conifer trees dominate the over-story in this smaller campground of 9 sites. Each site provides a picnic table, fire ring and a Food Storage Box. Drinking water is provided in the form of a hand-pump near the entrance of the campground. ... Access to this campground is via a dirt road approximately 4 miles from the end of the pavement.'; 'Sites may be reservable and reservation fees apply.'; 'Seasons of Use June 17th'; 'Single Site: $12 per night'; Pinedale Ranger District 307-367-4326; Latitude 43.253887 Longitude -110.018556; 'Upon entering the Bridger-Teton National Forest WY-352 changes to Union Pass Road (Forest Road 370600) and Whiskey Grove Campground is a 2.4 miles down the road to the left.'; '34 miles, 52 minutes'; 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'

https://www.fs.usda.gov/sites/nfs/files/legacy-media/bridger-teton/Whiskey_Layout_CG.D7.pdf (FS layout map linked from the page as /media/105442, read 2026-11-20): one loop of sites 1-9 inside a bend of the Green River, toilet in the loop, fee station and hand pump at the entrance; 'all sites are back in only / 1,2,4,6,8 are small sites 25-35 feet / 3,5,7,9 are larger sites 35-60'

https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10289175 (read 2026-11-20): phone N/A; notices 'First come, First served sites', 'Garbage Service in NOT available, please "Pack it in, Pack it out"', 'NO LIVESTOCK, this includes Horses, mules, donkeys, LLamas, Alpacas', '14 DAY STAY LIMIT', 'Starting 07/15/24 There will be an active gravel pit operating at the nearby Kendall Guard Station. Operations will be held between sun up and sun down'; amenities 'Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Vault Toilets', 'River Access', 'Food Storage Locker'; rates 'First-come, First-served Season' 2026-06-01..2026-11-30 $12 (2027, 2028 the same); scan-and-pay; catalog 9 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites, none reservable

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (1 km and 240 m frames): the FS/rec.gov point is the turnoff on Union Pass Road ~600 m east; the campground is a dense conifer grove inside a tight meander of the Green River (~28-35 m wide), with the loop under continuous canopy; individual pads not visible; stored pin at the grove's south entrance

values.note: Pay at the fee station (scan-and-pay on recreation.gov). Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: recreation.gov 10289175 ('First come, First served sites'; '14 DAY STAY LIMIT'; catalog none reservable) + FS page check-in times, read 2026-11-20

values.note: All back-in. Sites 1, 2, 4, 6 and 8 take 25-35 ft; sites 3, 5, 7 and 9 take 35-60 ft.

sites.source: FS layout map Whiskey_Layout_CG.D7.pdf ('all sites are back in only / 1,2,4,6,8 are small sites 25-35 feet / 3,5,7,9 are larger sites 35-60') + FS page ('9 sites'), read 2026-11-20

facilities.source: FS page ('Drinking water is provided in the form of a hand-pump near the entrance'; 'Vault toilet(s)') + recreation.gov amenities ('Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Vault Toilets'), read 2026-11-20

fees.source: FS page ('Single Site: $12 per night') + recreation.gov 2026/2027 rates $12, read 2026-11-20

note: Bridger-Teton NF campground in a conifer grove inside a bend of the upper Green River, off Union Pass Road about 34 miles northwest of Pinedale; the last ~4 miles are dirt. Hand-pump water at the entrance. No livestock. Pack out trash. A gravel pit operates by day at the nearby Kendall Guard Station. --Claude
summary: FS page + FS layout PDF + rec.gov read: 9 FCFS back-in sites 25-60 ft (note's 'most to ~23 ft' was wrong; max_rig 60), $12, 14-day, vault toilets, hand-pump water (all manual). WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE riverfront -> riverview (loop under continuous canopy; river ~30 m). Phone empty -> 307-367-4326. Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE riverfront -> riverview (stored value not --AWH): the loop sits inside a tight meander of the Green River (~28-35 m wide here, so river not creek), but under continuous conifer canopy ('Conifer trees dominate the over-story') with no site visible on imagery; the layout map puts sites 7, 8 and 9 on the river side of the loop (around 43.2570,-110.0262) with their spurs toward the bank, but no site can be shown within ~50 m over open ground. Sites are FCFS by the night.

SITES: the sweep note's 'most sites small (to ~23 ft) but a couple fit any size rig' is contradicted by the FS layout map (1, 2, 4, 6, 8 25-35 ft; 3, 5, 7, 9 35-60 ft) - every site fits a 23-ft rig; max_rig_ft 60.

FS BOILERPLATE CONFLICTS: 'Potable water is not available at this site.' vs the same page's 'Drinking water is provided in the form of a hand-pump' and recreation.gov 'Drinking Water (hand pump)' - potable true written. 'Sites may be reservable' vs recreation.gov (no reservable site; 'First come, First served sites') - recreation.gov written.
SEASON: FS 'Seasons of Use June 17th' (no close); recreation.gov FCFS rate season 06-01..11-30. Left unset.
PHONE: empty -> 307-367-4326 (Pinedale Ranger District, FS page). Websites confirmed.

PIN: stored 43.25569,-110.02583 at the grove's south entrance, ~100 m from the loop centre (~43.2567,-110.0255) - fine. The FS/recreation.gov point 43.253887,-110.018556 is the Union Pass Road turnoff ~600 m east (not the campground).
